items.name: TCP connections and their cost
items.explanation: TCP lets two hosts open a connection and exchange data reliably. Opening one takes round trips, so reusing an open connection saves time.

assumedBy.quote: Our machines establish TCP connections to origin servers to proxy HTTP requests.

items.name: HTTP status codes
items.explanation: Every HTTP response starts with a three-digit status code that says how the request went. Codes in the 500s mean the server failed.

assumedBy.quote: HTTP status codes are defined in RFC 9110 as a three digit integer, and generally expected to be in the range 100 through 599.
